## 2920da6abe8a

**Reproduced defect — advertised generator path is outside the canonical domain and crashes the authority.** In source SHA-256 `14e0c877bf47e3d9298955d6f29d591b011ab019cfa9d3498b538e294bb15170`, `AXES["texture"]` advertises `no_marker`, `two_markers`, and `full_grid`. The exact call `generate(seed=17, sample_index=0, difficulty="easy", texture="no_marker")` returns an all-zero 3×3 grid. Its meta-aware `self_check(..., meta={"texture": "no_marker"})` returns `[]`, but the supported canonical-domain check rejects it with “expected exactly 1 non-zero cell, found 0,” and canonical Racket rule hash `6e2213db7e3f` fails with `list-ref: index #f is not an exact nonnegative integer` (apply exit 1).

The isolated audit preset also found no task-local tests and failed the required semantic contract; standalone lint failed for missing `RULE_HASH` plus six warnings, and the override gate found 401 issues over 14,670 draws, including inert axes and acceptance of unknown keys. Exact reproducer and authority receipt: `checks/audit/2920da6abe8a/counterexample.json`, `checks/audit/2920da6abe8a/racket.json`, `checks/audit/2920da6abe8a-combined/result.json`, `checks/audit/2920da6abe8a-lint/`, and `checks/audit/2920da6abe8a-override/`. I made no changes to the audited generator.

## 2920da6abe8a

**Source binding.** Generator SHA-256
`14e0c877bf47e3d9298955d6f29d591b011ab019cfa9d3498b538e294bb15170`;
authority SHA-256
`e3ec9df904449cce0be06f755e5f3a0a977a590f4e24adedeb92e2a7d88f31ab`.

**Finding `A-2920-POSITION-LOOKUP-1` — concrete teaching shortcut.** The strict
semantic audit failed because the task declares no semantic contract. I then
materialized one exact production-style easy episode at seed 0. Its three
demonstrations place the marker at `(2,1)`, `(2,2)`, and `(2,0)`; the query places
it at unseen position `(0,2)`. A finite rival that memorizes the output mask for
seen marker positions and predicts blank for unseen positions fits all three
demonstrations exactly, yet differs from Racket authority on 45 query cells.
This proves one real ambiguous lesson, not its population frequency.

**Reproduction.** From `WORK/repo`:
`python3 ../run_with_racket.py python3 ../checks/audit/2920da6abe8a/teaching_lookup_probe.py`.
The executable probe and retained exact grids are
`checks/audit/2920da6abe8a/teaching_lookup_probe.py` and
`checks/audit/2920da6abe8a/teaching_lookup_probe.json`. The strict audit failure
is retained under `checks/audit/2920da6abe8a-combined/`.

**Scope.** I checked the strict semantic gate, the exact Racket labels, the
model-visible three-demo/query assembly, and one plausible position-lookup
rival. This was audit-only; no repair was made.
